messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: [INCIDENT] gpu-pool-us-east queue growth detected, autoscaler unable to scale beyond configured max. Throttles increasing.

maya (oncall): Getting alerts: sustained queue growth for the text-gen pool in us-east. 429s up and p95 latency climbing. Paging SRE and runtime.

ops-bot: @maya (oncall) you are on-call. Use /incident to file and tag responders.

maya (oncall): /incident open gpu-exhaustion-us-east — tagging @devon (runtime) @eli (infra) @rachel (sre). Initial glance: recent infra config pushed for prefix-cache ttl change ~10m ago.

devon (runtime): Looking at batcher metrics now. continuous_batch_window_ms was increased to 140ms in the last rollout. Concurrently prefix_cache_hit dropped from 0.9 -> 0.25.

devon (runtime): From runtime logs: 
```
2026-03-15T16:19:12Z INFO batcher: window_ms=140 avg_batch_size=12 enqueue_latency_ms=320
2026-03-15T16:19:13Z WARN batcher: prefix_cache_miss_rate=0.74
2026-03-15T16:19:14Z ERROR autoscaler: scale_request denied: reached_max_replicas current=48 max=48
```

eli (infra): Confirmed — autoscaler config max_replicas was set to 48 for this pool. There was also a servlet config change (commit d12f7) that reduced kv prefetching. Both merged ~12:15Z.

rachel (sre): Customer reports: high-volume tenants seeing 504s on long completions. Support tickets starting. Carlos, can you coordinate customer comms?

carlos (support): On it — posting initial advisory to affected customers, noting we're investigating and will share ETA.

amanda (sre-lead): Immediate mitigations: (fastest first)
- revert prefix-cache servlet change (fast deploy)
- temporarily raise autoscaler.max_replicas to 96 (needs approval)
- reduce continuous_batch_window_ms to 50ms via feature flag rollback
- route critical tenants to alternate region/pool (if feasible)

maya (oncall): I'll take the revert + batch window toggle. Eli, please advise on autoscaler bump.

eli (infra): I can increase max_replicas to 96 in 30s. Cost approval from SRE-lead?

amanda (sre-lead): Approved for 45m emergency. Do it.

ops-bot: deploy start: revert-prefix-servlet d12f7 -> revert-3324 (initiated 16:21:50Z).

ops-bot: feature-flag update: continuous_batch_window_ms -> 50 (16:22:05Z).

eli (infra): Autoscaler max_replicas increased to 96 (16:22:40Z).

pagerbot: deploy revert-3324 succeeded in us-east (16:22:51Z).

rachel (sre): Metrics update: within 90s of changes, queue length dropped ~55%, 429s down from ~9k/5m to ~900/5m. p95 improved but some tails remain.

devon (runtime): Observed behavior explanation: Longer batch windows combined with a high prefix_cache_miss_rate cause fewer coalesced batches and larger per-request enqueue time when KV misses push requests down to GPUs individually. The autoscaler hit the hard cap so requests accumulated.

maya (oncall): Customer impact summary (prelim):
- Incident window: 16:15:00Z -> 16:23:00Z (mitigations started 16:21Z, mostly effective by 16:23Z).
- Impacted routes: hosted text-gen endpoints in us-east-1. Embeddings unaffected.
- Severity: elevated error rate and latency for ~8% of requests during window. Several premium customers hit timeouts; Support notified.

carlos (support): Sent update to customers with apology and ETA for postmortem. Will attach incident ID and brief timeline.

amanda (sre-lead): Post-incident actions:
- add adaptive batching policy: if prefix_cache_miss_rate > 0.5 for 2m then reduce batch window and alert runtime team (DEV-5121).
- autoscaler: emit early warning when queue growth > 1000 req/min or when scale_request rejected 3x in 1m (INFRA-3344).
- rollout guard: any prefix-cache or kv-prefetch change must include KV warmup job and canary on a single shard (OPS-2106).

devon (runtime): Filing followups: BUG-RUNTIME-7621 adaptive batching + backpressure, TASK-RUNTIME-7622 rerun load tests with high miss rates.

eli (infra): I'll add an alert rule and dashboard tiles for prefix_cache_miss_rate, and instrument autoscaler to publish rejected_scale_count metric.

rachel (sre): We'll prepare a short postmortem draft and link logs and commits (d12f7, commit for batch-window change f9a3b). I'll own the timeline section. @devon help with root cause analysis.

maya (oncall): Marking incident mitigated. If anything regresses, reopen. Thanks everyone for quick action. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: INCIDENT_STATUS: mitigated -> closed by @maya (16:25:50Z)

maya (oncall): I'll circulate the postmortem draft to SRE and Runtime tomorrow and then to Customer Ops for sign-off.

carlos (support): Will follow up with customers after postmortem ready.
